cases.source_locator: iRPS Technical Spec / Sensor Mounting Type
cases.query: The sensor shall support through-shaft mounting.
cases.decision_rationale: A generic product capability does not prove project-specific design release.

cases.query: The sensor shall meet ASIL C functional-safety requirements.
cases.decision_rationale: The generic ASIL capability requires project-specific architecture evidence.

cases.query: The sensor supply shall be 5 V with the project-specified tolerance.
cases.decision_rationale: Generic electrical characteristics alone do not validate the requested tolerance.
cases.review_note: 5V/4.5-5.5V tolerance values may only exist in cross-project test specs (CSP31/TQ250), not in the product DOCX. Gold label needs domain expert verification.

cases.query: The sensor shall provide the requested analog sine and cosine output mode.
cases.decision_rationale: Output-mode capability is generic; the configured project interface still needs confirmation.

cases.source_locator: iRPS Technical Spec / Mechanical Airgap Range
cases.query: The sensor shall support the specified minimum, nominal, and maximum mechanical airgap.
cases.decision_rationale: Generic product guidance is not a substitute for project-specific tolerance validation.

cases.source_locator: iRPS Technical Spec / Operating Temperature Range
cases.query: The sensor shall operate from -40 C to 150 C.
cases.decision_rationale: The product-family range is relevant but is not project qualification evidence.

cases.query: The sensor shall support a 24000 rpm motor speed range.
cases.decision_rationale: Speed support depends on pole-pair and application configuration.

cases.query: The product cleanliness shall follow the customer drawing.
cases.decision_rationale: The authoritative evidence is a drawing and must not be fabricated from text-only RAG.

cases.source_locator: iRPS Technical Spec / Output signal type
cases.query: The sensor shall provide analog sine/cosine output signals.
cases.decision_rationale: Product family supports analog output but project-specific configuration needs confirmation.

cases.query: The sensor shall withstand vibration levels per automotive standards.
cases.decision_rationale: Generic vibration capability stated; project-specific vibration profile needs validation.

cases.query: The sensor shall support the specified through-shaft mounting configuration.
cases.decision_rationale: Through-shaft mounting is a product family capability; specific mechanical interface needs validation.

cases.source_locator: iRPS Technical Spec / Electrical angle accuracy
cases.query: The sensor shall provide electrical angle measurement with specified accuracy.
cases.decision_rationale: Angle accuracy depends on pole-pair count and application-specific calibration.

cases.query: The sensor shall provide diagnostic functions for functional safety compliance.
cases.decision_rationale: Diagnostic capability exists in product family; project-specific safety architecture needs review.

cases.query: The sensor shall meet ESD immunity requirements per ISO 10605.
cases.decision_rationale: ESD immunity is a standard product feature; specific test levels need project validation.

cases.query: The sensor shall operate reliably under high humidity conditions.
cases.decision_rationale: Product family humidity range is available; specific test conditions need confirmation.

cases.query: The sensor shall use the specified electrical connector type.
cases.decision_rationale: Connector type is project-specific and may vary from generic product information.

cases.query: The sensor output signal shall maintain adequate signal-to-noise ratio.
cases.decision_rationale: SNR depends on installation environment and cable routing, not just sensor specification.

cases.source_locator: iRPS Technical Spec / Reverse polarity protection
cases.query: The sensor shall include reverse polarity protection on the power supply.
cases.decision_rationale: Reverse polarity protection is a standard product feature but implementation details need review.

cases.query: The sensor shall survive thermal cycling between minimum and maximum operating temperatures.
cases.decision_rationale: Thermal cycling endurance depends on cycle count and dwell time specifications.

cases.query: The sensor shall provide redundant sensing channels for safety-critical applications.
cases.decision_rationale: Product supports dual-channel output; specific redundancy architecture needs project validation.

cases.query: The sensor weight shall not exceed the specified limit.
cases.decision_rationale: Product weight is documented in product information; project limit needs comparison.

cases.query: The sensor power consumption shall be within the specified budget.
cases.decision_rationale: Typical power consumption is documented; specific budget and operating conditions need validation.

cases.query: The sensor electromagnetic emissions shall comply with CISPR 25.
cases.decision_rationale: EMC compliance is tested at project level; generic product EMC data is reference only.

cases.query: The sensor shall meet IP6K9K ingress protection rating.
cases.decision_rationale: Product family IP rating is documented; specific sealing design needs project validation.

cases.source_locator: iRPS Technical Spec / Shaft diameter tolerance
cases.query: The sensor shall accommodate the specified shaft diameter with tolerance.
cases.decision_rationale: Shaft diameter range is specified in product information; specific tolerance needs matching.

cases.query: The sensor shall achieve valid output within the specified startup time after power-on.
cases.decision_rationale: Startup time is a product-level characteristic; specific requirement needs comparison.
